unison_suggestHideOtherVersions.description: Label of the other versions toggle while it is open; clicking it hides the suggested videos judged to be different recordings again

unison_videosLoadFailed.description: Shown in place of the linked or suggested videos list when Unison could not load it; a retry button follows

unison_showMore.description: Button that reveals the rest of the suggested videos list beyond the first few

unison_error_linkCapReached.message: Link limit reached for this lyric
unison_error_linkCapReached.description: Error shown when a lyric already has the maximum number of linked videos

unison_error_durationMismatch.description: Error shown when a video cannot be linked because its duration differs too much from the lyric

unison_error_videoUnverifiable.description: Error shown when a video cannot be linked because Unison could not fetch it

unison_error_cannotUnlinkPrimary.message: The primary video can't be removed
unison_error_cannotUnlinkPrimary.description: Error shown when the user tries to unlink the primary video of a lyric

unison_rev_number.description: Revision label. $rev$ is the revision number

unison_rev_original.description: Label for revision 1 of a Unison lyric, the original upload

unison_rev_neverEdited.description: Revision bar text for a lyric with no edits. $when$ is a relative time

unison_rev_editedAgo.description: Revision bar text for the live revision. $when$ is a relative time

unison_rev_pendingChip.description: Chip for an edit waiting for council review

unison_rev_revisions.description: Button and page title for the list of a lyric's revisions

unison_rev_editLyrics.description: Button that opens the lyric editor

unison_rev_viewChanges.description: Button that opens the diff of the pending edit, and link in the editor save bar that opens the Changes tab

unison_rev_changes.description: Editor tab that lists what the edit changes compared with an earlier revision

unison_rev_changesTabs.description: Screen reader label for the editor tabs that switch between the lyric preview and the list of changes

unison_rev_details.description: Diff section label above changed song details: language, ISRC and album

unison_rev_updating.description: Shown while the list of changes refreshes after an edit

unison_rev_checkFailed.description: Editor save bar title when the edit check failed for a reason the server did not explain

unison_rev_checkFailedHint.message: Save turns back on once the check runs.
unison_rev_checkFailedHint.description: Editor save bar hint under the failed check title, followed by a Try again link

unison_rev_tryAgain.description: Link or button that runs the edit check again after it failed

unison_rev_changesError.description: Error title in the editor Changes tab when the edit check failed

unison_rev_changesErrorHint.message: Something went wrong. Your draft is safe, and the preview still works.
unison_rev_changesErrorHint.description: Error hint in the editor Changes tab when the edit check failed

unison_rev_changesNeedParse.message: Changes return once the lyrics parse.
unison_rev_changesNeedParse.description: Editor Changes tab while the lyrics have errors that stop them from being read

unison_rev_withdraw.description: Button that withdraws a pending edit before the council reviews it

unison_rev_reason_sealed.description: Why an edit needs council review: the council approved (sealed) this lyric

unison_rev_reason_flagged.description: Why an edit needs council review: an automatic check flagged it

unison_rev_reason_largeText.description: Why an edit needs council review: too much of the text changed

unison_rev_reason_largeTiming.description: Why an edit needs council review: too much of the timing changed

unison_rev_goesToReview.description: Editor outcome before saving. $reason$ is a review reason, like 'Large text change'

unison_rev_pendingTitle.description: Title for a saved edit that waits for review. $reason$ is a review reason, like 'Large text change'

unison_rev_staysLive.message: Revision $rev$ stays live until the council decides.
unison_rev_staysLive.description: Names the revision listeners keep seeing during review

unison_rev_rejectedTitle.description: Title when the council rejected an edit

unison_rev_councilNote.description: The note the council left when it rejected an edit

unison_rev_sealedHint.message: Every edit goes to council review before it goes live.
unison_rev_sealedHint.description: Explains what editing a sealed lyric means

unison_rev_status_live.description: Revision status: the version listeners see

unison_rev_status_pending.description: Revision status: waiting for council review

unison_rev_status_superseded.description: Revision status: replaced by a newer save before review

unison_rev_status_rejected.description: Revision status: the council rejected it

unison_rev_status_withdrawn.description: Revision status: the owner withdrew it

unison_rev_anchor.description: Chip on the revision that edits are measured against

unison_rev_approved.description: Revisions list reason for a council-approved revision

unison_rev_withinLimits.description: Revisions list reason for an edit that went live without review

unison_rev_reverted.description: Revisions list reason and success message for a revert

unison_rev_driftValues.description: How much text and timing an edit changed, as whole numbers

unison_rev_colChange.description: Revisions list column header (noun): how much an edit changed

unison_rev_colWhen.description: Revisions list column header: relative time

unison_rev_revision.description: Column header and editor sidebar label

unison_rev_comparedWith.description: Line above a diff. $rev$ is the compared revision

unison_rev_legendAdded.description: Diff legend: added lines or words

unison_rev_legendRemoved.description: Diff legend: removed lines or words

unison_rev_legendTiming.description: Diff legend: lines whose timing changed but text did not

unison_rev_headSection.description: Label above the diff rows for text stored outside the lyric lines: translations, romanizations and credits

unison_rev_headCredits.description: Diff row label for a changed credit, such as a songwriter or singer name

unison_rev_headLine.description: Part of a diff row label that names the lyric line a translation or romanization belongs to, e.g. 'Translation · Spanish · line 3'

unison_rev_noDiff.description: Diff area when there is nothing to compare

unison_rev_revertToThis.description: Button that starts a revert to a past revision

unison_rev_revertLive.message: Reverting goes live now as revision $rev$
unison_rev_revertLive.description: Note before a revert that skips review

unison_rev_revertCheckFailed.message: Couldn't check whether reverting goes live or to council review
unison_rev_revertCheckFailed.description: Note on a past revision when the check of where a revert would land failed; the owner can still revert and the server decides

unison_rev_revertReview.message: Reverting goes to council review as revision $rev$
unison_rev_revertReview.description: Note before a revert that needs review

unison_rev_locked.message: Song and artist can't be edited.
unison_rev_locked.description: Editor note about fields that are locked

unison_rev_editsLeft.description: Edits left in the last 24 hours

unison_rev_textChanged.description: Meter label: how much of the text changed

unison_rev_timingChanged.description: Meter label: how much of the timing changed

unison_rev_textChangedSince.description: Meter label: how much of the text changed since an earlier revision that the limit is measured against. $rev$ is that revision

unison_rev_timingChangedSince.description: Meter label: how much of the timing changed since an earlier revision that the limit is measured against. $rev$ is that revision

unison_rev_ofLimit.description: Follows a bold percentage in a meter, like '8% of 15% limit'

unison_rev_checkLine.description: A server check message tied to a line. $message$ comes from the server

unison_rev_checking.description: Editor status while the server checks the edit

unison_rev_fixErrors.description: Editor status when the edit has errors

unison_rev_limitReached.description: Shown when the daily edit limit is used up

unison_rev_noChanges.message: No changes from the live revision
unison_rev_noChanges.description: Shown when an edit or revert would change nothing

unison_rev_goesLive.description: Editor status when the edit skips review

unison_rev_submitForReview.description: Save button label when the edit needs review

unison_rev_noEdits.description: Revisions page notice for a lyric that was never edited
